Key: # Every kind of gear. Keep the Key values (the game finds each row by its Key
Name: and how each kind fights is in the code); every other column can be changed.

Key: # DamageMin / DamageMax: a TIN weapon's damage (better tiers add steps
Name: see Tiers.csv). Range: reach in centimetres. Cooldown: seconds between swings.

Key: # Defence: a TIN armour piece's or shield's defence (x the tier's DefenceMult). BuyPrice: a BRONZE piece's store price (x the tier's PriceMult; capes use it as is).
# Mass: how much material smithing it takes. SmithExtraLevel: added to the tier's Smithing level (not for tin). TwoHanded: yes = no shield with it.

Name: Sword
Blurb: The all-rounder: quick, reliable hits. Swing left to right, then right to left for a fast combo. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Axe
Blurb: Hits harder than a sword and chops trees faster. Equip it (or let it auto-select) to chop. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Pickaxe
Blurb: A mining tool first and a weapon only in a pinch. Better pickaxes mine faster and unlock harder ore.

Name: Spear
Blurb: Long reach. Hold the attack button to charge a lunge. A shield can be carried with it.

Name: Broadsword
Blurb: A heavy two-handed blade: slow swings, big damage. Cannot be used with a shield.

Name: Battle Axe
Blurb: The biggest hitter and the slowest. Two-handed, no shield.

Name: Katana
Blurb: A pair of light curved blades, one in each hand. Very fast, modest hits. No shield.

Name: Wand
Blurb: Fires small magic bolts at range. Light and quick.

Name: Wizard Staff
Blurb: A wizard's staff: slow, heavy bolts from far away. Two-handed, no shield.

Name: Bow
Blurb: Fires arrows from a distance: hold the attack button to draw (the longer the draw, the further and harder the shot), let go to shoot. Arrows run out: buy them at the store or smith them, or pick up the ones you shot (E). Better arrows hit harder. Needs both hands: no shield.

Name: Fishing Pole
Blurb: A fishing pole. Equip it and click towards the pond. Better poles bite faster and reach rarer fish.

Name: Shield
Blurb: Hold right-click to block blows from the front. A shield's guard stops damage up to its Defence; once spent, the guard is broken and stops only half of each blow until it recovers (10 s after the last blow, then 10 s to refill). Not usable with two-handed weapons.

Name: Helmet
Blurb: Protects the head. Defence adds to the total of all worn armour.

Name: Chestplate
Blurb: The heaviest armour piece and the biggest defence bonus.

Name: Shoulders
Blurb: Layered pauldrons for the shoulders.

Name: Gloves
Blurb: Armoured gauntlets for the hands.

Name: Boots
Blurb: Armoured boots. Better boots also give you more stamina: it lasts longer and returns faster.

Name: Cape
Blurb: Your cape shows your PvP rank: Tin, Iron, Bronze, Steel, Silver, Gold, then your class's legendary colour. It is yours for good: never dropped, sold or traded. (PvP ranks come later: for now every knight wears Tin.)

Name: Ring
Blurb: Rings shift damage and defence. Three miscellaneous slots hold any mix of rings and amulets. Every effect is on top of the weapon's own damage range.

Name: Amulet
Blurb: Wears in one of your three miscellaneous slots. Some change the damage rules in strange ways.
